summary: Charts gains charts/homelab-shared (library, 0.1.0): the eight HelmCharts helpers copied under the homelab-shared.* prefix, and the Terraform PreSync hook Job as homelab-shared.tf-presync-hook with the estate pin hook.imageTag: "1" in the library's values. The repo also earns its gate: .kubecoder/project.yaml (root component, jenkins: IaC/Charts) lints the library and runs tests/render-consumer.sh, which renders tests/consumer — a fixture taking the library as its one dependencies: entry — and asserts all nine surfaces plus the prefix's negative case. kc project lint and kc project test are green; HelmCharts is untouched.
